Commentary.Commentary: The visitors did not look confident at the beginning by losing two quick wickets in the first over of the match. However, the experience of Taylor and Raza tried to build a partnership but that did not last long. Sikandar Raza once again proved to be vital for them as with his helpful knock of 52, they managed to get past the 150-run mark along with some vital contribution by PJ Moor towards the end of the innings. Let's see what the run chase has on offer for us. Will the Bangla Tigers chase this down with ease or is there a twist in the tale?

At the end of first innings, Zimbabwe are all out for 170 as they perished in the 49th over. The hosts began the game well by handing over the new ball to both their left-arm spinners who bowled a really tight spell in the start. They gave them early wickets and did not let any partnership build. The fast bowlers came into the picture during the middle overs where they did not give away much of the loose delivers to capitalize on. Once again, their death overs specialists, Mustafizur Rahman and Rubel Hossain proved key for them as they both bagged two wickets each.

OUT! ZIMBABWE HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 170! Absolute peach from the Fizz to finish things off and bag his second wicket. Runs in from around the wicket and arrows a yorker on the stumps, too good for Blessing who can't do anything about that. The stumps behind him are rattled and that's the end of the Zimbabwean innings.
The batsman has been struck on the thigh pad. They pick up a single. The umpire signals leg bye.
Back of a length delivery around off, Muzarabani gets a leading edge through cover and takes one.
Deceives the batsman with a slower one again. Blessing like a proper tailender looks to slog across the line but misses.
Fuller again, Jarvis gets a thick outside edge which flies through the vacant backward point position. Single taken.
Cutter from Mustafizur, around off, Jarvis swings hard across the line only to be beaten.
Full again, outside off, hit away to the man positioned in the cover region.
Full and wide outside off, Blessing leaves it alone. No hat-trick for Rubel.
Blessing Muzarabani is the last man in for Zimbabwe.

OUT! RUBEL IS ON A HAT-TRICK! Another yorker on off, Chatara looks to hit it out on the off side but can't deal with the ferocity of the delivery. Gets an inside edge back onto his stumps and he goes back to the dressing room as fast as he came out.
Tendai Chatara is the new man in.

OUT! BOWLED 'EM! This is excellent death bowling from Rubel Hossain. Comes steaming in and spears in the perfect yorker on middle. Moor makes room to hit it through the off side but misses and has his stumps shattered. The set batsman is gone.
Wristy shot as it's turned through mid-wicket for a run.
Yorker fired in straightaway, good delivery to start the over. Peter Moor just about digs it out down the ground towards long on and takes one.
Rubel Hossain returns to the attack.
This time he nicks it but it falls just short. Slower one again, Jarvis edges it behind but Rahim can't collect it before it falls to the ground.
Slower in pace, outside off, Jarvis plays and almost get a nick on it.
Superb piece of bowling from the Fizz! Brings out the bouncer out of nowhere, takes Jarvis by surprise who can't do much else but barely duck out of the way.
Full outside off, driven through the covers for a single. Jarvis wanted the second, but is sent back by Moor.
Cutter outside off, Moor hangs his bat inside the line and gets beaten as a result.

Wide! Maybe there was some pad on it, if not bat? Because Rahim is confident there's some sound. Down the leg side, Moor looks to flick but misses. Replays show the sound is of the ball brushing the thigh pad.
Length delivery shaping away from outside off, punched out off the back foot.

In the air... but safe! Tossed up on the stumps, Jarvis clears his front leg and looks to go big downtown. Instead, he gets a top edge which flies down to long on. Tamim Iqbal goes running behind from mid on but can't get to the ball in time. Two runs taken.
Works it against the spin on the leg side. Dot ball.
Jarvis takes a big lunge forward, gets close to the pitch of the tossed up ball and defends.
Kyle Jarvis is next in to bat.

OUT! That's a good catch out in the deep! After facing a few dot ball, Graeme Cremer decided he wanted to go after this time. Looked to launch the full ball over the long off fence, but instead found Rubel Hossain who dived forward and took a stunning catch.
Straighter one from Shakib, Cremer once again plays it in Shakib's direction.
Slower through the air, slightly short in length, Moor hits it through the right of the bowler and takes a single.
Drops it with soft hands on the off side and scurries to the other end to complete the run.
Graeme Cremer has punched the ball off the back foot through the covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Stays back and keeps this one out.
Picks it off his pads and flicks it through backward square leg for a run.
Just ahead of a length outside off, Cremer pushes it down to long off for a single.

Run out chance goes to waste! Full outside off, Moor crisply drives it through the covers. Cremer instantly takes off for the second without even looking at the ball and is halfway down the track. But, to his fortune, Shakib in the deep throws it at the wrong end. The Zimbabwean skipper is able to get back in the crease and make it in safely.
Mustafizur Rahman is back into the attack.
Moor ends the over by driving it down the ground for a single. He will keep the strike for next over.
FOUR! Asking to be put away. Shakib drags it short, Moor was quick to see it. He rocks back and pulls it towards the mid-wicket region for a boundary. Poor bowling by the experienced campaigner.
Moor leans into the drive and plays it towards the mid off fielder.
Close! Shakib tossed this one outside off, Moor tries the slog sweep but did not manage to put any bat to it. It did not miss the off stump by much.
Moor pushes it off the front foot towards the cover region.
Shakib gives it some air as Cremer lofts it to long on for a single.
Moor tries to be innovative and plays a reverse sweep but does not manage to get his bat to it.
Hossain bowls it quicker this time. Moor tries to go for the sweep but it hits his pads. The Bangla Tigers appeal for an LBW but the umpire does not seem interested.
Cremer flicks it towards the square leg area for a single.
Hossain tosses it up towards the batsman, Cremer plays it off the front foot.
Moor pulls a short delivery towards deep square leg area and will give the strike to his partner,
Hossain drags this short, Cremer punches it off the back foot towards mid-wicket region for a single.
Nasir Hossain will have change of ends.
Punched off the back foot by Cremer as he will keep the strike for next over.
Shakib gives it some air as Moor drives it to long on and the batsmen run through.
Cremer sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Tossed up delivery defended off the front foot.
Moor punches it off the back foot towards the long on fielder for a single.
Shakib darts this one on the stumps, Cremer plays it down the ground for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan is back into the attack.
FOUR! A cracker of a shot by Moor. Mortaza bowls it full outside off. Moor lofts this one over the cover fielder for a much needed boundary. He wouldn't miss out on deliveries like these.
Moor tries the flick but misses it as it hits his pads on high.
Mortaza drops this one short outside off, Cremer punches it off the back foot towards the cover region for a single.
A dot ball. Cremer drives it to mid on.
Moor cuts the wide ball outside off towards the cover region for a single.
Mortaza drags it on the legs, Cremer flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. It means maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Cremer flicks it to mid-wicket for a single to end the over with.
Hossain tosses it up as Cremer drives it straight back at him.
Moor punches the ball down the ground for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. The batsmen run through for a single.
Cremer punches it off the back foot towards the mid-wicket region.
Graeme Cremer comes in to bat next.

OUT! Run out. This is the last thing the visitors would have hoped for, seeing their key man getting back in the hut. He flicks it to short fine leg and calls for the run but his partner did not respond. A diving Raza could not get back in his crease. Shakib picks up and throws it flat towards Rahim who dislodges the stumps within no time. A big wicket at this stage of the match for the Bangla Tigers. A fine knock of 52 comes to an end in a sad manner.
Third umpire has been asked for. There is a run out appeal against Raza. Let's see if he has made it or not.
Mortaza finishes it up by bowling it full on the stumps, Moor drives it to mid off.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Mortaza bowls it full on the stumps, Raza leans into the drive and hits it towards long on for a single.
Another dot. Raza drives it to the cover fielder.
Mortaza bowls a short of a length ball outside off, Raza square cuts this to the point fielder.
Raza drives a full delivery to mid off.
Hossain tosses it up on the stumps as Raza pushes it to long on for a single. He will keep strike for the next over.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

FOUR! Classical cover drive by Raza. He brings up his fifty in style. His 9th fifty in ODIs and 1st against Bangladesh. Hossain tosses it up outside off, Raza comes dancing down and whacks it towards the cover region for a boundary. He's doing it again for his team. Raza has always stepped up when his team needs him the most. Needs to carry on and play till the end to get his team to a fighting total.
Raza flicks it to short fine leg, as Hossain drags this one short.
Raza plays it towards the mid-wicket region. It was full and on the pads, didn't get any run for it though.
Tossed up delivery on the legs, Moor plays it to the short fine leg fielder for a single.
Drinks break.
Mortaza bowls it short and wide, Raza cuts it towards the point fielder. Had he hit that with a little bit of precision the result would have been different.
Raza cuts the short ball towards the point fielder.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot towards the long on region for a single.
FOUR Leg Byes! Poor by the captain. He dragged this delivery full down the leg side, Moor goes for the flick but it hits his pads and the ball runs down to the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Raza punches it towards the mid-wicket region and gives the strike to his partner.
Mortaza starts by dragging it short down the leg side, Sikandar clips it off his hips towards the fine leg region and the batsmen pick up a brace.
Mashrafe Mortaza is back into the attack.
Raza drives the ball towards long on for a single to end the over with.
Tossed up delivery outside off, Raza shows his full face of the bat.
Hossain drags it short outside off, Raza cuts it towards the point region.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Quick, full and outside off, Raza opens the face of the bat towards as the bowl rolls towards the point region.
Hossain gives some air to the ball, Raza plays it to the square leg fielder.
Bowls an off cutter outside off stump to end the over with. The batsman leaves it alone.
Short of a length delivery outside off stump, Raza punches it to mid-wicket region for a single.
Short outside off, PJ Moor plays it to square leg and will give his partner the strike.
Moor defends it off his front foot back at the bowler.
Rahman drags it short on the stumps, Raza hangs back and plays it to square leg for a single.
Rahman pitches it up full outside off, Moor leans into the drive and gets the ball towards the cover region for a single.
Hossain drags it short, Moor punches it down the ground for a single to end the over.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket region.
Hossain slows his pace and pitches it on a good length. Moor tries the sweep but it hits him on his pads. The Bangla Tigers appeal but the umpire is not interested.
Fires this one on the legs, Moor misses the flick and the ball hits his pads.
Drags this one short on the stumps, Raza plays it to deep square leg for a single.
Hossain starts by tossing it up on the stumps, Raza plays it to mid-wicket.
Nasir Hossain is back on.

This keeps a little low. Mustafizur hurls it well outside off on a length, Peter Moor stretches his arms out to connect, but the low bounce sees the ball go off the under edge behind to the keeper on the bounce.
Little straightish in line once more, flicked away through mid-wicket for a single.
Full and angling in, too straight in line though. Allows Sikandar Raza to turn it away behind square on the leg side and come back for the second.
Shaping away, on a good length, played to point.
Goes full, on the stumps this time, it's kept out with a straight blade. His head was quite steady there, well done. Good balance shown.
Angles it away from the batsman, on a good length, Raza lets it be.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on.
Full outside off, pushed back down the track, back to the bowler.
Top edge which falls safely. Moor is a bit early into the sweep shot as the ball is coming slower through the air. It takes the top edge and goes over the slip fielder for a couple.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slightly fuller in length  and outside off, Moor once again brings out a defensive shot.
Arm ball just around off, coming in, Moor is solid in defense.
Full and around off, slower through the air, eased down through mid off to get off strike.
Short, flat and outside off, Raza meets it with the full face of the bat as he slaps it past point for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Comes forward this time. Landed full, it's blocked.
Seeing the ball dropped short, Raza hangs back and keeps it out.
Leans into the full delivery and drives it through the covers for one run.
Slider around off, Moor stays back and keeps it out.
Positions himself perfectly behind the line and sees the over out without any danger.
Quicker on the stumps, worked away towards mid-wicket for a single.
Width on offer, outside off, Moor has something to work with as he cuts it square on the off side for a couple of runs.
Spinning away from around off, worked away to point with the spin.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Looped up delivery, defended off the front foot.
SIX! BANG! Half-tracker and that will be punished by Sikandar Raza! The batsman rocks back, has all the time in the world as he muscles the pull over mid-wicket for a maximum.

Good lord! That wasn't far off at all! Shakib, after tossing a lot of slow ones, provides some pace on this. Raza is caught by surprise as the ball almost skids through. Takes the inside edge and goes past the leg stump for a double.
Camps behind, punches it on the off side. Takes no run for it though.
Makes use of his feet, gets close to the pitch of the ball and deals with it easily.
Comfortably done. PJ Moor eases it down the ground, towards long off and takes a single.
Tossed right up there, on the stumps, comes forward and blocks it back down the track.
Shakib Al Hasan is back into the attack.
Arm ball from the bowler, blocked away rather easily.
Wide! Down the leg side, wide signalled by the umpire.
Played to mid-wicket region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Knocks the full ball to long off by coming forward and crosses over.
Waits for the ball to come to him as it's slower through the air, pushed to the cover region.
Short and flat, Raza offers a solid punch down towards long off and calls his partner through for a single.
Fired it full on the stumps, Sikandar Raza just about manages to dig this one out off the inner half.
Hangs deep inside his crease and guards it out to end the over.
Nothing delivery outside off, on a length, punched to point. Dot ball.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Wicked movement on that. Length delivery jagging back in from around off, Raza leaves it alone after covering the line but it's a little too close for comfort.

FOUR! Shot! Short and wide, Raza's eyes light up as he stands tall and crashes it through point. This is probably his only option now. Wickets are falling from the other end, so it's on him now to get the runs while he can.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Around off with some turn on it, blocked by Moor.
Peter Moor next in to bat. Two slips in place for him.

OUT! He's gone this time! No third life for Malcolm Waller. Rather sad really for Zimbabwe, they'd have hoped he would have carried on and made the most of the lives given to him. Flatter and quicker on off, turns a bit as Waller looks to cut. Not enough room to do so and he draws an edge as a result. Into Sabbir Rahman's hands who keeps a hold of it. Zimbabwe fall deeper.
Comes forward and defends the full delivery with utmost ease.

Dropped! Bit difficult, but you can argue it should have been taken. Quite full on middle and off, Waller hits it straight back to the bowler. Islam can't hold on, puts it down. Initially it looked like it was a bump ball, but on watching the replays it became clear that it was a straight catch.
Fuller, slower and drifting in on middle, Raza wrists it through mid-wicket for a single.
Hangs behind the line of this one as he guards it out safely.
FOUR! Shot! Was expecting that, really. The full one was coming after several short ones. Waller leans ahead and cracks it through the covers for a boundary.

Five Wides! One too many from Rubel. Bangs it short but it's too short, Waller has nothing to do with it. The keeper rises and he misses the ball. Over his head and away to the boundary line. Wide called by the umpire as well, so five runs in total.
Bumper again, Waller arches back and lets it be.

Nicely done by Raza. He flicks this in front of square on the leg side and runs the first one hard. Wants the second but is sent back by his partner. Rightly so too, as the fielder got to the ball rather fast.
Length ball outside the line of off stump, played to point. One run taken.
Bouncer to start the over. Waller picks it up early and comfortably ducks to avoid it.
Full toss which Raza punches through mid-wicket. Easy two and that will be the end of the over.
Flatter and quicker this time, easy enough for Waller to get back and punch it past extra cover for a run.

This is excellent, excellent bowling from Islam. Gives this some serious air as he tosses it just back of a driving length on off. Malcolm Waller is drawn forward and he plays at it, only to be beaten past the outside edge.
Waits for the ball to come to him, offers the full face of the bat to keep it out.
Leans ahead and knocks this full ball through the covers for a single.
That was close! Raza is almost undone here. Islam darts it full on leg, catches the batsman on the boot, but not before he can get some inside edge on it. Good bowling.
Short and wide, Waller cuts and cuts hard. Though, much to his dismay, it's straight to the point fielder. Either side of him and that was a boundary.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Wide outside off, Raza cuts it down towards third man for an easy run.
Length delivery outside off, punched firmly from inside the crease through the cover area. One run added to the total.
Fraction straight in line, coming back into the batsman. Raza works it behind square leg and takes one.
Some width on offer outside off, landed on a good length, Raza throws his bat at this but fails to make any kind of connection.
Plays with the spin as he hits it through point. One run to end the over.
Excellent use of the feet from Sikandar Raza. Dances down and drives it crisply through the cover region. Two runs taken as the two fielders in the deep mop it up.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Slower through the air, fuller in length, Raza takes a big stride forward and meets the ball at its pitch.
Nice drift in once again, Raza keeps it out safely.
Drifting in from around off, Waller pushes it through the covers and calls for the run.
Typical fast bowler's response from Rubel. Bumper on off, Raza ducks and evades.

Dropped! Easiest of catches, this. Should be taking that all day, every day. Rubel bangs it shorter around off, Waller cuts hard but the bounce gets a little big on him. The ball takes the edge and flies to Nasir at wide first slip. He just lets it slip from his palms. Poor effort. Single taken.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, tucks it behind square leg and crosses over.
Makes good connection on this as he drives it hard through to sweeper cover. Single taken.
Touch ahead of a length just outside off, driven to mid off.
Width offered outside off and Waller goes for it. Looks to flay this length length but connects only with thin air.
Rubel Hossain will be bowling his first spell of the innings.
Islam ends the over by darting it towards the batsman. Raza defends it off his front foot towards the cover region. Good over by Islam.
Islam loops it full on the stumps, Raza sees it off by playing on the front foot.
Islam tosses this on the stumps, Waller lofts it to long off for a single.
Looped up delivery on the stumps, Waller shows his full face of the bat.
Islam lands this one on a good length spot, Waller defends it back to him off his back foot.
Tosses it up outside off, Waller plays it off his front foot.
Mustafizur drags it short on the legs, Raza defends it well off his back foot to end the over with.
Mustafizur pitches it up full on the stumps, Raza plays it off his front foot.
Fizz rolls his finger on  this one and deliveries it full outside off.
Short of a length outside off, Raza defends it off his back foot.
Fizz lands this on a good length area outside off, Raza plays it off his back foot towards the cover fielder.
Mustafizur starts by pitching it up full outside off, Waller plays it to deep point fielder for a single.
Drinks break!
Full in length once more, driven square through cover-point for a single.
Tossed up outside off, driven to the cover area for nothing.
Lovely delivery! Slower through the air outside off, spins away just enough, beats the outside edge of Malcolm Waller's bat and thuds into the keeper's gloves.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Drags the length back on this, outside off, Raza pushes it through the left of the bowler for a single.
Starts off from around the wicket, Raza plays it square to point.
Sunzamul Islam is back into the attack.
OOoohhh... That was close! Length ball with some width offered outside off, Waller looks to thrash this through the off side but misses it altogether.
Three slips and two gullies in place for Malcolm Waller. This is something that wasn't expected. Well, interesting and bold to say the least...
Outside off on a good length, play and a miss from the batsman.
Malcolm Waller makes his way into the middle.

OUT! GONE! This is a big, big wicket for the hosts! Brendan Taylor, who was supposed to be the cornerstone of Zimbabwe's innings, is sent back. Seam up delivery outside off, Taylor fishes for it and is undone. He knows it, the moment the ball takes the edge and goes back, he knows he's gone. Mushfiqur Rahim doesn't make any mistake and Bangladesh are flying here.
Cutter from the Fizz, keeps it fuller around off and Taylor doesn't pick it up. Prods forward and is beaten past the outside edge.
Seaming away from around off, steered behind point. Wasn't too far away from the fielder, but just enough for the batsmen to pick up a single.
Touch short on middle stump, Brendan Taylor moves a step across and wrists it through mid-wicket to get off strike.
Dot ball to end the over. Firm punch from Sikandar Raza to the man at cover. It was on a good length and outside off, the batsman just played it away off the back foot.
Back of a length from Mortaza, kept out off the back foot with a straight bat.
Good carry through to the keeper. Slightly outside off, on a good length, shaping away as Raza shoulders his arms to it.
Short of a good length just outside off, Raza is watchful as he defends it under his nose from the back foot.

Takes the pace off it as it's landed on a length around off, Taylor drops it down with soft hands on the off side and calls Raza for the run. Both run fast and complete it relatively easily. Nicely done.
Bit fullish in length and outside off, Taylor plants his front foot forward and defends it off the inner half on the leg side.

SIX! First one of the innings. Rahman rolls his finger on the ball and bowls it full outside off. Raza goes in for the drive, but gets deceived by the slower one. He was in no control of the shot but the ball goes over the long on boundary for a maximum. Raza is not able to pick up Rahman's variation with the ball.
Rahman bowls an off cutter, back of a length on the stumps, Raza defends it off his back foot.

Play and miss. Raza looks to be struggling. Rahman pitches it full outside off and angling away from the batsman. Raza goes for the drive but misses it. He could have easily nicked it behind to the keeper. Excellent bowling by Mustafizur.
Rahman drags it a bit short outside off, Raza defends it off his back foot towards the cover region.
Raza plays it off the back foot to a ball landed on a good length area outside off.
Rahman starts by pitching it up and angling away from the batsman. Raza opens the face of the bat towards the point fielder.
Mortaza bowls it full and wide outside off, Taylor fails to put any bat to it.
The batsman shoulder arms to let that one through.
Mortaza is bowling a very good line. Bowls it outside off, Taylor shoulders arms this one.
Drags it down the legs, Taylor flicks it towards square leg for a brace.
Mortaza bowls it full on the stumps, Taylor defends it off his front foot straight back.
Mortaza lands this one on a good length area outside off, Taylor leaves it alone.
Raza edges a off cutter pitched outside off stump towards the gully fielder. A good over by Rahman comes to an end.
Raza cuts the short delivery outside towards the point region.
Pitched up delivery by Rahman, Raza defends it off his front foot.
Rahman drags this one short, Raza plays it off his back foot towards the square leg fielder.
Raza drives this to the cover fielder on a delivery pitched up by the bowler.
Well bowled! That was quick by Rahman. He lands this one on a good length area and the ball seamed away from the batsman. He gets beaten by the seam movement. Impressive by Fizz.
Mortaza drags this full on the legs, Raza flicks it to mid-wicket and will keep the strike for next over.
He follows up by bowling it full on the stumps, Raza shows his full face of the bat.
Mortaza drags it short on the stumps, Raza rocks back and plays it to mid-wicket.
Mortaza bowls it outside off stump, Raza leaves it alone.
He bowls it quick and full on the stumps, Raza plays it off his front foot back at the bowler.
Mortaza lands it outside off stump, Raza lets this one go.
The batsman has played that off the front foot to end the over with.
Rahman follows by pitching it up on the stumps, Taylor shows the full face of the bat towards the cover fielder.
Taylor plays off his back foot towards the square leg region on a delivery dragged short by Rahman.
Rahman lands it on a good length area outside off stump, Taylor plays it to the cover fielder off his front foot.
FOUR! Lovely timing by Taylor. Rahman bowls it full outside off stump, Taylor leans into the drive to get it past the cover fielder for a boundary.
Rahman starts by pitching it up outside off, Taylor plays it to mid off.
Mustafizur Rahman comes into the attack.
Mortaza bowls it wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Raza lets the delivery outside off go towards the keeper.

Mortaza drags it short on the legs, Raza looks to flick but closes the face a bit too early. It takes the leading edge and falls safely in the mid-wicket area. Lucky for Zimbabwe, they can't lose him at this point.
The batsman has played that off the front foot to a full delivery on the stumps.
Raza plays a short delivery towards the point region.
Wide! Mortaza drags this one way outside off stump, umpire signals it a wide.
Mortaza lands this one on a good length area outside off, Raza plays it off his front foot to the cover region.
Shakib tosses it towards the batsman, Taylor plays it back to the bowler off his front foot. Good end to the over.
Shakib gives it some air as Taylor plays it off his front foot.
Darts this one full outside off, Taylor shoulder arms.
Shakib loops it outside off, Taylor lets this one go to the keeper.
FOUR! Shakib tosses it up outside off and Taylor drives it through covers to register a boundary to his name. That sounded good off the timber.
Shakib darts it full on the stumps, plays it off the back foot.
Sikandar Raza is the next batsman in.

OUT! Mortaza gets his first one. Masakadza is out caught behind. Mortaza bowls it full outside off, Masakadza tries to hit it back over the bowler but only manages to find the outside edge behind in the keeper's hands. Needless shot to play, his team needed him to stick it out there with Taylor but instead he's back in the dressing room.
Mortaza bowls a back of a length delivery outside the off stump, Masakadza punches it of the back foot this to cover fielder.
Lands this one on a good length area on the stumps, he plays it to square leg for a single.
Mortaza drags this one short, Taylor rocks back and hits it to deep square leg for a brace.
Mortaza bowls it quick and full on the stumps, Taylor plays it to mid-wicket.
This one had a little shape to it. Mortaza bowls this outside off, Taylor lets this one go.
Driven through the covers for one more.
Pushes this full ball towards mid off for one.
Tossed right up there, Masakadza comes forward and meets it with a straight blade.
Pushed to the mid off region for an easy single.
Oh, that was so close! Lovely stuff from Shakib Al Hasan. Drifts it in on middle, it turns away and squares Brendan Taylor a bit. It goes off the outer half past the slip fielder.
Worked away on the leg side for a single.
Short of a good length close to off, cramps Hamilton for room as he can only play it back down the track.
FOUR! Some width on offer and Hamilton Masakadza doesn't miss out. Short and wide, he flays it through point and there's no stopping that. Hit that with a lot of power.
On a good length, just outside the line of off stump, Hamilton drops it in front of covers off the back foot.
Hits the deck hard, shortish in length, Masakadza hangs back and pushes it back in the bowler's direction.
In the channel outside off, some extra bounce on that occasion, Masakadza has a slash at it but misses.
Immediately goes full and attacks the off stump, Brendan Taylor leans across, gets behind the line and pushes it towards mid on for a quick single.
Outside off and it's pushed through the covers for a single.
Full delivery from the bowler, a solid block from the batsman.
Shakib with some excellent loop, attacks the stumps this time, another defensive shot presented in response to that.
Looped up, keeps it around off, blocked.
Another one floated outside off, Brendan Taylor meets it with the full face of the bat.
Slower through the air outside off, Taylor is forward in defense.
Islam ends with a tossed up delivery, Masakadza plays it straight back to the bowler.
Islam bowls this one quick, Masakadza rocks back and plays it to mid off.
FOUR! Islam drags this one short outside off, Masakadza was quick to see it. He rocks on the back foot and hits it over deep mid-wicket to register the first boundary.
Bowls this one quick on the stumps, Masakadza plays it off the back foot.
Lands this one right in the good length area. Taylor plays it off the front foot and finds the outside edge for a single.
Tossed up delivery on the stumps, Masakadza plays it to long off for a single.
Shakib darts this one quick towards the batsman, Masakadza plays it down the ground and will keep the strike for next over.
Drives the delivery angled into him from around off through the covers for a single.
Taylor defends a quicker delivery on the stumps off his back foot.
Wide! Shakib slides this one down the leg, umpire calls it a wide.
Tossed up delivery on the stumps, Masakadza lofts it over the cover region for a single.
Shakib angles this one to the batsman, Masakadza goes for the drive but inside edges onto his pads.
Shakib darts this one full on the stumps, Taylor plays it down the ground for a single.
Islam tosses it towards the batsman, Masakadza goes for the drive and finds the outside edge. The ball rolls from the right of the first slip fielder and they pick up a brace.
Drags this one down the leg, the batsman defends it off the back foot to square leg.
Tossed up on the stumps, the batsman defends it straight back.
Islam tosses this one outside off, Masakadza defends it off the front foot.
Darts this one full on the stumps, the batsman plays it back to the bowler.
Islam starts with a tossed up delivery on the stumps, Masakadza plays it off the front foot towards the cover region.
Sunzamul Islam will bowl from other end.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Around off, slider from Shakib, it takes the inside edge of the batsman's bat and hits him on the pads.
Wide! The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Taylor works this through the mid-wicket area and picks up two runs to get off the mark.
Zimbabwe are already in a spot of bother here with two wickets lost inside the opening over of the game. Now, Taylor and Masakadza must form a partnership, a big one too.
Brendan Taylor in at No.4.

OUT! Two in the over for Shakib. He bowls it towards the batsman. Ervine, who is new to the crease, goes for the flick, but chips it and gives away an easy catch to Sabbir Rahman at mid-wicket. Got beat by the flight of the ball and got undone because of it. The hosts are up in front from the first over.
Shakib tosses it outside off to the new batsman. He goes for the push but misses the line of the ball to see it get into Rahim's gloves.
Craig Ervine walks in at No.3.

OUT! Stumped! Sharp keeping by Rahim. Shakib slides this one down the leg side, Mire misses the flick and loses his balance. Rahim quickly dislodges the bails and he appeals for the stumping. It's taken upstairs. Replays show that he wasn't able to plant his foot back inside the crease in time and as a result, he will have to go back to the pavilion. An early breakthrough for the Bangla Tigers, just the start they would have wanted. The umpire signals it a wide.
Drama straightaway! Stumping appeal against Solomon Mire is taken upstairs. Looks close...
Shakib starts by tossing the ball up outside off, Masakadza goes for the drive but inside edges this one to the short fine leg fielder and opens the account.
We are ready to begin. Solomon Mire and Hamilton Masakadza stride out to bat. Shakib Al Hasan will bowl first up. Interesting. Spin to begin things. He has a slip in place. Here we go...

Graeme Cremer says they would have batted anyway. Adds the wicket looks a little tacky, but doesn't think it will change much. Is still positive about their victory over Sri Lanka, mentions plus having Kyle Jarvis and Brendan Taylor back in the side is a big bonus. Reckons it's nice to have quite a few games before the upcoming World Cup Qualifiers, as he wants to pick his best XI for it.

Mashrafe Mortaza says they would like to bowl first. Reckons there will a lot of dew, a bit cloudy, so would like to take advantage of that. Says it's always nice to play at home, so is looking forward to that. Mentions Imrul Kayes is not in the side due to a finger injury, and that they are going with two spinners with Shakib and Nasir and have three quicks.

Pitch Report - Athar Ali Khan doing the pitch report mentions that it has been cold the last week or two. Adds despite it being a 12 O' Clock start, you can expect the white ball to do things for the bowlers. Continues saying the track is a bit damper, not much grass on it though. Feels the first 30-40 minutes the ball will move around, but after that, the batsmen will enjoy their time in the middle. States the average score on this ground is 264. Ends stating again that once the batsmen see out that early period, the wicket will be a good one for batting.
TOSS - Bangladesh win the toss and opt to field!

The likes of experienced Hamilton Masakadza, Sikandar Raza, Malcolm Waller and Craig Ervine will have to pull up their socks and bring their A game to give them a tough fight. We expect a crackerjack of the inaugural match of the Tri-Nation Series. Join us at 1130 IST for live action.

On the other hand, the visitors, who are ranked last, will look to make a mark in the one day format. They will be boosted by the arrival of Brendan Taylor and Kyle Jarvis in the ODI colors. Their coach, Heath streak, having spent with the Bangladesh team, will add his inputs and help the batting department to excel.

Hello, folks! Welcome to the first match of the Tri-Nation Series which involves Bangladesh, Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe. We are here at the Shere Bangla National Stadium, Dhaka for our first encounter between Bangladesh and Zimbabwe. Even though they did not play any ODI in 2017, the hosts go in as the favorites as they have been in prolific form at home. Tamim Iqbal has been notching up crucial runs at the top of order by playing his natural game, while the experienced campaigners - Shakib Al Hasan, Mahmudullah and Mushfiqur Rahim in the middle order will help them take the game forward. Their captain, Mashrafe Mortaza, will lead from the front in the bowling line along with the likes of Mustafizur Rahman and Mehidy Hasan who have been proved their worth every time they step on the field.
